implementation: Add canonical CMATERIAL inventory/parser/writer handling and stateless noexcept full-string32-bit hex/presence query. Dollar/bare model aliases are accepted singly, wrong codes/types/duplicate aliases and embedded NUL refuse. Existing generic HEADER duplicate/shape checks remain. Supplied values require R2007+; absence remains absent. No new DRW_Header instance/virtual state.

The core owns exactly one remap after the header callback, replacing the same supplied alias. A nonzero header material enables actual inventory only for the attempt and requires MATERIAL in OBJECTS before publication, including direct callbacks; future inventory policy remains unchanged. Direct callers still own dictionary/graph semantics.

Add optional guarded borrowed HEADER byte inspection. The view includes opening group2 HEADER, excludes SECTION/ENDSEC and contains prepatch HANDSEED. Unwind record/state scopes before resetting the writer, and rebase the staged relative seed offset with overflow checks. Default empty observer retains streaming.

The facade keeps a constant-size current target/presence/provider-owner/data/generation/format/version snapshot. Inspect returned-copy CMATERIAL fields against the admitted paired/rooted DXF source, then actual MATERIAL identity/owner. Inputs with materials activate absent-header protection too. Ordinary material-free/absent2D has no new observer, row inventory or retained variable copies. Unqualified non-DXF nonzero facade references continue to refuse.

Fix persistent OOM abort: precompute target basename/directory before output exists and borrow the native temporary basename on POSIX identity, publication and unlink paths. No heap-allocating filename/parent extraction remains in noexcept identity/rollback checks. Keep fd-relative operations, no-follow flags and inode/directory ownership comparisons. Windows native cleanup remains unqualified.

Make diagnostic recording tolerate allocation failure while retaining first scalar phase/cause/location and dropping optional text. Catch bad_alloc in DXF write as Allocation/ResourceLimit. Remove allocating temporary lookup keys from the existing noexcept REQUIREDVERSIONS/CEPSNID queries. The getLastDiagnostic snapshot itself is not promised allocation-free.
